s: Pharaoh has strength that will become shame (for those who trust in him)
q: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

s: the LORD is a Holy One of Israel
q: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says,

s: the LORD is God of justice
q: for the LORD is a God of justice.

s: the LORD takes away supply of bread and water (from Jerusalem and Judah)
q: the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

s: people of Jerusalem and Judah parades sin like Sodom (do not hide their sin)
q: They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it.

s: people of Jerusalem and Judah is led astray by leaders and elders (of Judah) (leaders destroy the way of their paths)
q: My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

s: people of Jerusalem and Judah is oppressed by boys and children (rulers of Judah) (children are their oppressors)
q: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them.

s: leaders and elders (of Judah) holds plunder of the poor (in their houses)
q: The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

s: leaders and elders (of Judah) eats up vineyard (the beloved's vineyard)
q: It is you who have eaten up the vineyard.

s: leaders and elders (of Judah) crushes the poor (grinds the face of the poor)
q: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?”

s: daughters of Zion has trait arrogant (walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes)
q: the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

s: daughters of Zion is punished with Judgment and punishment of Judah (sores and bald scalps)
q: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

s: the LORD gives as rulers boys and children (rulers of Judah) (as princes over Jerusalem and Judah)
q: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

s: adornments and finery (of the women of Zion) is taken away by the LORD (in that day)
q: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

s: Judgment and punishment of Judah includes falling of men by the sword (men and mighty in war)
q: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

s: the LORD stands to judge (judges the peoples)
q: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

s: the LORD enters into judgment with leaders and elders (of Judah) (accuses them of eating up the vineyard)
q: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders

s: Jerusalem has state ruined
q: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen;

s: Judah has state fallen
q: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen;

s: Jerusalem has part gates (Jerusalem's) (gates will lament and mourn)
q: Her gates shall lament and mourn.

s: Jerusalem has state desolate (future, sitting on the ground)
q: She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

s: people of Jerusalem and Judah acts against the LORD (in tongue and doings)
q: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

s: the LORD is a Holy One of Israel
q: but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek the LORD!

s: children of Israel possesses idols of silver and gold (made by their own hands)
q: everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

s: those who help Egypt (reliance on Egypt) relies on horses, chariots and horsemen (because they are many and strong)
q: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong

s: those who help Egypt (reliance on Egypt) fate stumble and be consumed (when the LORD stretches out his hand)
q: both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

s: Assyria fate fall by a sword not of man
q: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him.

s: Assyria has young men status subject to forced labor
q: He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

s: Assyria has princes state afraid of the banner
q: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,”

s: the LORD has attribute wise
q: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words

s: the LORD has title LORD of Armies
q: so the LORD of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

s: the LORD protects Jerusalem (likened to hovering birds)
q: As birds hovering, so the LORD of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it.

s: the LORD has fire in Zion
q: says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

s: the LORD has furnace in Jerusalem
q: says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

s: Egyptians is a men, not God
q: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God

s: Egyptians has horses that are flesh, not spirit
q: and their horses flesh, and not spirit.

s: children of Israel has status deeply revolted against the LORD
q: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

s: righteous king (throne in the tent of David) reigns in righteousness (future reign)
q: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness

s: women at ease faces vintage and harvest failure (after days beyond a year)
q: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail.

s: my people has land overgrown with thorns and briers (future)
q: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land

s: my people will live in peaceful habitation (also safe dwellings and quiet resting places)
q: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places

s: joyous city has houses of joy (to be overgrown with thorns and briers)
q: on all the houses of joy in the joyous city

s: joyous city will be deserted (populous city, future)
q: The populous city will be deserted.

s: Spirit is poured on my people (from on high, future)
q: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high

s: wilderness becomes fruitful field (after the Spirit is poured out)
q: and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field

s: wilderness will have justice (dwelling there)
q: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness

s: fruitful field will be considered forest (after the Spirit is poured out)
q: and the fruitful field is considered a forest

s: fruitful field will have righteousness (remaining there)
q: and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field

s: fool speaks folly (disposition)
q: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity

s: righteousness produces peace (its work)
q: The work of righteousness will be peace

s: righteousness produces quietness and confidence (its effect, forever)
q: the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever

s: fool works iniquity (in his heart)
q: and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity

s: fool will not be called noble (in the coming reign)
q: The fool will no longer be called noble

s: scoundrel has ways evil
q: The ways of the scoundrel are evil.
